fields.summary_ko.0: Fortinet (FTNT) declined 5.9% on October 28, but Q3 earnings of $0.91 exceeded the expected $0.86, and revenue of $2,078.4M slightly exceeded estimates.
fields.summary_ko.1: Revenue increased 20% YoY, with product revenue up 37% and service revenue up 13%, providing Q4 median guidance of 15% revenue growth.
fields.summary_ko.2: Due to sharp growth deceleration in one business segment, post-acquisition decline of 26%, down 11% from the October 9 high of $194.75 after a 12-month gain of 104.1%.
